name: Necrotic Bolt (Recharge 4-6)
description: The creature fires a bolt of necrotic energy at one target it can see within 30 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or take 9 (1d6 + 6) necrotic damage. In addition, nonmagical armor worn by the target is partly dissolved and takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to the AC it offers. The armor is destroyed if the penalty reduces its AC to 10.
